      Supply & Replenishment

      Do receipts match orders, and is the replenishment buffer adequate across lead times and supplier reliability levels? Unreceived quantities are cancelled in this simulated policy.

      Planned orders vs received packs by month

      The order rule covers forecast demand for the month plus the lead-time fraction plus safety stock, less opening stock.
      No rows match the current filters.

      Service by contracted lead-time band

      Stockout month share and safety stock as % of demand. Shorter lead times receive smaller buffers under the current rule.
      No rows match the current filters.

      AI Demand Forecasting: Ridge Regression vs Baseline

      Supervised log-demand ridge regression trained on Jan 2023-Aug 2025, tuned on Sep-Dec 2025 and tested once on the untouched Jan-Apr 2026 holdout. Predictions were generated in Python and are embedded here; the scenario explorer re-scores the exported model in your browser.

      Limitations and correct interpretation

        Data Governance & Methods

        Validation evidence, KPI definitions and reconciliation to the reference publication. All results are computed from the assigned master CSV, which was not modified.

        Dataset profile

        All enterprise entities and outcomes are fully synthetic. Findings describe the simulated enterprise, not real pharmaceutical markets, patients or clinical outcomes.
